record.bible_text: For, behold, the Lord<WH0113>, the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>, doth take away<WH05493><WTH8688> from Jerusalem<WH03389> and from Judah<WH03063> the stay<WH04937> and the staff<WH04938>, the whole stay<WH04937> of bread<WH03899>, and the whole<WH03605> stay<WH04937> of water<WH04325>,
The mighty man<WH01368>, and the man<WH0376> of war<WH04421>, the judge<WH08199><WTH8802>, and the prophet<WH05030>, and the prudent<WH07080><WTH8802>, and the ancient<WH02205>,

The captain<WH08269> of fifty<WH02572>, and the honourable<WH05375><WTH8803> man<WH06440>, and the counsellor<WH03289><WTH8802>, and the cunning<WH02450> artificer<WH02791>, and the eloquent<WH0995><WTH8737> orator<WH03908>. <RF>the honourable...: Heb. a man eminent in countenance<Rf> <RF>eloquent...: or, skilful of speech<Rf>
And I will give<WH05414><WTH8804> children<WH05288> <FI>to be<Fi> their princes<WH08269>, and babes<WH08586> shall rule<WH04910><WTH8799> over them.

And the people<WH05971> shall be oppressed<WH05065><WTH8738>, every one<WH0376> by another<WH0376>, and every one<WH0376> by his neighbour<WH07453>: the child<WH05288> shall behave himself proudly<WH07292><WTH8799> against the ancient<WH02205>, and the base<WH07034><WTH8737> against the honourable<WH03513><WTH8737>.

When a man<WH0376> shall take hold<WH08610><WTH8799> of his brother<WH0251> of the house<WH01004> of his father<WH01>, <FI>saying<Fi> , Thou hast clothing<WH08071>, be thou our ruler<WH07101>, and <FI>let<Fi> this ruin<WH04384> <FI>be<Fi> under thy hand<WH03027>:

In that day<WH03117> shall he swear<WH05375><WTH8799>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, I will not be an healer<WH02280><WTH8802>; for in my house<WH01004> <FI>is<Fi> neither bread<WH03899> nor clothing<WH08071>: make<WH07760><WTH8799> me not a ruler<WH07101> of the people<WH05971>. <RF>swear: Heb. lift up the hand<Rf> <RF>healer: Heb. binder up<Rf>

For Jerusalem<WH03389> is ruined<WH03782><WTH8804>, and Judah<WH03063> is fallen<WH05307><WTH8804>: because their tongue<WH03956> and their doings<WH04611> <FI>are<Fi> against the LORD<WH03068>, to provoke<WH04784><WTH8687> the eyes<WH05869> of his glory<WH03519>.<CM>

The shew<WH01971> of their countenance<WH06440> doth witness against them<WH06030><WTH8804>; and they declare<WH05046><WTH8689> their sin<WH02403> as Sodom<WH05467>, they hide<WH03582><WTH8765> <FI>it<Fi>  not. Woe<WH0188> unto their soul<WH05315>! for they have rewarded<WH01580><WTH8804> evil<WH07451> unto themselves.
Say<WH0559><WTH8798> ye to the righteous<WH06662>, that <FI>it shall be<Fi> well<WH02896> <FI>with him<Fi> : for they shall eat<WH0398><WTH8799> the fruit<WH06529> of their doings<WH04611>.

Woe<WH0188> unto the wicked<WH07563>! <FI>it shall be<Fi> ill<WH07451> <FI>with him<Fi> : for the reward<WH01576> of his hands<WH03027> shall be given<WH06213><WTH8735> him. <RF>given...: Heb. done to him<Rf>

<FI> As for<Fi> my people<WH05971>, children<WH05953><WTH8781> <FI>are<Fi> their oppressors<WH05065><WTH8802>, and women<WH0802> rule<WH04910><WTH8804> over them. O my people<WH05971>, they which lead<WH0833><WTH8764> thee cause <FI>thee<Fi> to err<WH08582><WTH8688>, and destroy<WH01104><WTH8765> the way<WH01870> of thy paths<WH0734>. <RF>lead...: or, call thee blessed<Rf> <RF>destroy: Heb. swallow up<Rf>
The LORD<WH03068> standeth up<WH05324><WTH8737> to plead<WH07378><WTH8800>, and standeth<WH05975><WTH8802> to judge<WH01777><WTH8800> the people<WH05971>.

The LORD<WH03068> will enter<WH0935><WTH8799> into judgment<WH04941> with the ancients<WH02205> of his people<WH05971>, and the princes<WH08269> thereof: for ye have eaten up<WH01197><WTH8765> the vineyard<WH03754>; the spoil<WH01500> of the poor<WH06041> <FI>is<Fi> in your houses<WH01004>. <RF>eaten: or, burnt<Rf>

What mean ye <FI>that<Fi> ye beat<WH01792><WH00> my people<WH05971> to pieces<WH01792><WTH8762>, and grind<WH02912><WTH8799> the faces<WH06440> of the poor<WH06041>? saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069> of hosts<WH06635>.<CM>

Moreover the LORD<WH03068> saith<WH0559><WTH8799>, Because<WH03282> the daughters<WH01323> of Zion<WH06726> are haughty<WH01361><WTH8804>, and walk<WH03212><WTH8799> with stretched forth<WH05186><WTH8803> necks<WH01627> and wanton<WH08265><WTH8764> eyes<WH05869>, walking<WH01980><WTH8800> and mincing<WH02952><WTH8800> <FI>as<Fi> they go<WH03212><WTH8799>, and making a tinkling<WH05913><WTH8762> with their feet<WH07272>: <RF>wanton...: Heb. deceiving with their eyes<Rf> <RF>mincing: or, tripping nicely<Rf>

Therefore the Lord<WH0136> will smite with a scab<WH05596><WTH8765> the crown of the head<WH06936> of the daughters<WH01323> of Zion<WH06726>, and the LORD<WH03068> will discover<WH06168><WTH8762> their secret parts<WH06596>. <RF>discover: Heb. make naked<Rf>

In that day<WH03117> the Lord<WH0136> will take away<WH05493><WTH8686> the bravery<WH08597> of <FI>their<Fi> tinkling ornaments<WH05914> <FI>about their feet<Fi> , and <FI>their<Fi> cauls<WH07636>, and <FI>their<Fi> round tires like the moon<WH07720>, <RF>cauls: or, networks<Rf>
The chains<WH05188>, and the bracelets<WH08285>, and the mufflers<WH07479>, <RF>chains: or, sweet balls<Rf> <RF>mufflers: or, spangled ornaments<Rf>
The bonnets<WH06287>, and the ornaments of the legs<WH06807>, and the headbands<WH07196>, and the tablets<WH05315><WH01004>, and the earrings<WH03908>, <RF>tablets: Heb. houses of the soul<Rf>
The rings<WH02885>, and nose<WH0639> jewels<WH05141>,
The changeable suits of apparel<WH04254>, and the mantles<WH04595>, and the wimples<WH04304>, and the crisping pins<WH02754>,
The glasses<WH01549>, and the fine linen<WH05466>, and the hoods<WH06797>, and the vails<WH07289>.

And it shall come to pass, <FI>that<Fi> instead of sweet smell<WH01314> there shall be stink<WH04716>; and instead of a girdle<WH02290> a rent<WH05364>; and instead of well set<WH04639> hair<WH04748> baldness<WH07144>; and instead of a stomacher<WH06614> a girding<WH04228> of sackcloth<WH08242>; <FI>and<Fi> burning<WH03587> instead of beauty<WH03308>.
Thy men<WH04962> shall fall<WH05307><WTH8799> by the sword<WH02719>, and thy mighty<WH01369> in the war<WH04421>. <RF>mighty: Heb. might<Rf>

And her gates<WH06607> shall lament<WH0578><WTH8804> and mourn<WH056><WTH8804>; and she <FI>being<Fi> desolate<WH05352><WTH8738> shall sit<WH03427><WTH8799> upon the ground<WH0776>. <RF>desolate: or, emptied: Heb. cleansed<Rf><CM>
